newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 7.86 bln lvs 3-mth, floater T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 7.86 bln lvs 3-mth, floater T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry sold 7.86 billion levs of three-month, floater coupon T-bills yielding 20.66 percent until maturity at an auction on Friday, the central bank said.
The coupon was set equal to the central bank main interest rate of 6.20 percent monthly, which goes in force on Monday and will be effective on the issue date of May 2.
Bids were received for 7,977.5 billion levs worth of T-bills but the ministry approved bids for 7,859.5 billion levs of paper.
The issue was offered with no par value or minimum acceptable price set in advance.
